items.title: From rivals to partners: Polygon and Solana team to bring stablecoin payments to banks
items.summary: The two networks are setting aside their rivalry to connect Solana's stablecoin activity with Polygon's banking, wallet and payment infrastructure.

items.title: Why Switzerland’s first genuine spot bitcoin ETF could soon attract overseas banks and brokers
items.summary: SIX Swiss Exchange confirms international access, while FINMA explains why it approved the fund and whether ether and solana ETFs could follow.

items.title: Polygon expande Open Money Stack para Solana após lançamento na Tron
items.summary: A mudança ocorre após a adição do suporte à Tron e a aquisição da Coinme pela Polygon.
